description: Append an audit line after Cloudflare deploy tools run. It does not send notifications; use /deploy's Slack step for that.

hooks.command: tool=$(jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); printf '[%s] devops-flow deploy tool completed: %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$tool" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/devops-deploy-audit.log" 2>/dev/null || true
